card.name: The word same, where repetition is expected
card.fires_on: Mostly the word "same" after "the" when something is described as identical or reused, such as the same size, questions, or line. Also fires on nearby words like "recurrence" and "unique".

modes.label: The same + noun
modes.description: The word "same" after "the" signals sameness or reuse of an item.
modes.example: are all the<< same>> small size--eighteen by twelve inches

modes.label: Recurrence wording
modes.description: Words about something happening again, such as recurrence of a reaction.
modes.example: or<< recurrence>> of Grade 1 or 2 IL

modes.label: Reuse of a system
modes.description: The noun after "reapply the same" that points back to an earlier item.
modes.example: reapply the same<< system>> or apply a new system

card.writes: It lowers words about repeating, identical, and duplicate things, so it suppresses repetition words after sameness cues.
card.plain: It spots places where the text says something is the same or happens again.
